name: Weiguo Wang (王伟国)
introduction: I work on research and engineering at ByteDance, focusing on on-device LLMs, speech and audio technologies, and voice agents for mobile hardware.
research: My research combines acoustics, signal processing, and machine learning, with an emphasis on translating physical insights into working systems. I investigate how physical signals carry information about the world, and how algorithms and hardware can be designed together to enable sensing, communication, and interaction under real-world constraints. More recently, I have extended this perspective to LLMs, exploring how sound can support physical understanding.
education: I obtained my Ph.D. degree from Tsinghua University, advised by [Prof. Yuan He](http://tns.thss.tsinghua.edu.cn/sun/members/YuanHe).
